code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia). Renal function markers (urea, creatinine) are elevated, and there is mild hypoglycemia and low total protein. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic hypoxic and renal dysfunction, bone marrow suppression or infiltration, and possible infection or systemic illness. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
